quantified_case_split.claim: Every nonempty fixed menu B of nonnegative 5-exponents with |B| <= 2 fails for some positive N congruent to 5 modulo 12.
quantified_case_split.if_0_absent: N=5 has no legal restricted square from B; its witness uses b=0.
quantified_case_split.menu_0: N=12233 fails for b=0 and is rescued at b=2.
quantified_case_split.menu_0_1: N=1595477 fails for b in {0,1} and is rescued at b=2.
quantified_case_split.menu_0_2: N=1750109 fails for b in {0,2} and is rescued at b=1.
quantified_case_split.menu_0_k_k_at_least_3: N=12233 fails at b=0, while 4*25^k >= 62500 > 12233; it is rescued at b=2.

source_target: OEIS A308661 / Sun ternary 5 mod 12 conjecture
